summary.text: Winfield Clark is a Republican nominee for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 28 (3 seats), in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A pastor, nonprofit leader and consultant, he says in a Ballotpedia survey that he grew up in Charles County and lives in Waldorf.

paragraphs.text: Winfield Clark graduated from McDonough High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Hampton University in 2003 and a graduate degree from the University of Iowa in 2010.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his degrees are a B.S. in electrical engineering and an MBA.

He described his work as that of a pastor, nonprofit leader, consultant and educator, including serving as president and CEO of Celestial Manna, a faith-based food security nonprofit, and currently serving as a pastor at New Life Marbury.
Clark advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary with 47.8% of the vote, second to James Ashburn.
His stated campaign messages are economic growth, infrastructure improvements and government efficiency.
